data.description: Create a durable system for recording every deferred item and driving each deferral to either completion, explicit cancellation, or replacement by a newer tracked task. Requirements: no deferred work may exist only in chat/router prose; deferrals need owner, reason, dependency/unblock condition, priority, source reference, and next review trigger. Integrate with Knots workflow and router handoffs so deferred work remains discoverable after compaction/session changes.
